extracted.intended_audience: followers, subscribers and contributors to The Salvation Army's social media channels
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational guidelines for people who post, comment or otherwise contribute on The Salvation Army's social media platforms. Covers desired tone and behaviour, detailed prohibitions, moderation consequences, reporting contact, and privacy/retention notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community purpose and values
rubrics_metrics.description: Salvation Army welcomes honest, friendly and open conversation and values the interaction and freedom that social media affords. We commit to encouraging a thriving, inclusive, and transparent online community where every voice is valued and respected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These guidelines are designed for our followers and subscribers, who are keen to share ideas and experiences and communicate with each other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Our social media presence encompasses Facebook, Threads, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube and Flickr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rules apply across these named platforms where The Salvation Army operates; a committed team constantly moderates these platforms to ensure they remain a safe environment for all users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderation authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Our committed team constantly moderates our platforms to ensure they remain a safe environment for all users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To keep our social media helpful community and safe for everyone, we reserve the right to remove comments which breach the guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: No disruptive/provocative/attacking/offensive posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Are considered likely to disrupt, provoke, attack or offend others
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such posts may be removed by moderators as they harm constructive conversation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay on-topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Are off-topic for the thread of conversation in question
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments should be relevant to the post or discussion they appear under; repeatedly off-topic contributions can be removed or blocked.

rubrics_metrics.name: No discriminatory, sexually explicit or abusive content
rubrics_metrics.description: Are racist, sexist, homophobic, sexually explicit, abusive or otherwise objectionable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content that targets protected characteristics or contains explicit or abusive material is not permitted and will be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No swearing or language likely to offend
rubrics_metrics.description: Contain swear words or other language likely to offend
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid coarse language or phrasing that could reasonably offend other community members.

rubrics_metrics.name: No illegal content or encouragement of unlawful activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Could break the law or condone or encourage unlawful activity (this includes breach of copyright, defamation and contempt of court)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posts that are illegal, that encourage illegal acts, or that infringe others' legal rights will be removed and may be referred to authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: No commercial advertising for profit
rubrics_metrics.description: Advertise products or services for profit or gain
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform is not a marketplace for unsolicited commercial promotion; overt advertising may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No impersonation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pretending to be another person or organization is prohibited and may result in removal and blocking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not post personal contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: Include contact details such as phone numbers, postal or email addresses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing personal contact information in posts/comments is disallowed and such content will be removed to protect privacy and safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: No content that endangers others
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe or encourage activities which could endanger the safety or well-being of others
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material that promotes dangerous behaviour or puts people at risk will be removed and may be reported to relevant authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: No spam or repetitive posting
rubrics_metrics.description: Are considered to be 'spam' (posts containing the same message posted multiple times)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated identical messages or mass-posting behavior will be treated as spam and removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No trolling or deliberately disruptive statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Are ‘trolling’, or posting deliberately disruptive statements meant to hijack comment threads or throw discussions off-track, or are repeatedly off-topic for the comment, discussion or post on which you are posting .
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliberate attempts to derail or provoke discussions are not tolerated and may lead to removal and blocking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation implies agreement to guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: By participating, contributors agree to uphold these guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posting or commenting constitutes acceptance of the rules and the moderators' decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences for repeated breaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Contributors who repeatedly breach the guidelines will have their comments removed and be blocked from further contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moderators may remove single offending comments, and repeated violations will lead to blocking from contributing further.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to report inappropriate usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Please report any inappropriate usage to IHQ-Website@salvationarmy.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although moderators work to keep pages safe, users are asked to notify the organisation via this email if they see problematic content.

rubrics_metrics.name: External links are not endorsements
rubrics_metrics.description: The appearance of external links on this site does not constitute official endorsement on behalf of The Salvation Army.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links posted by users should not be interpreted as the organisation's endorsement of the linked content or services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy, public nature and retention of contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that all responses to Salvation Army web pages, Facebook links and status updates, X posts, etc are public. Contributions may be re-used in other Salvation Army communications. All comments, links and posts made on this page, including those removed by us and any response made, are retained by The Salvation Army. Information posted may be passed to relevant authorities and organisations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not post content you expect to be private; contributions can be republished, archived, and shared with third parties or authorities.
